title: Memory store: automatic compaction schedules + receipt backfill
summary: Memory compaction is implemented, but operators still need a deterministic way to schedule compaction and backfill receipts for legacy rows. Add a small automation surface that can run in dry-run mode and emits JSON output for audit.
expectedFailureModes: Compaction schedules are undocumented/manual and drift into ad hoc scripts.
Receipt correlation stays incomplete for legacy rows, blocking provenance and audit narratives.
A compaction run mutates state without a corresponding receipt trail.
nextAction: Add a read-only/dry-run capable CLI subcommand that computes compaction candidates + expected receipt changes, then add a separate opt-in execution path that records receipts.
